source: depauw-university-2025-2026-catalog.pdf, prerequisite sentence of each course entry, verbatim (catalog typos kept). MATH-441 is from the Prerequisites column; CSC-396/496 and MATH-495 have no Prerequisite: label so the eligibility sentence is used.

prereq_text.CSC-396: Open to students by permission of instructor or to those who satisfy prerequisites determined by the instructor.
prereq_text.CSC-398: Permission of instructor and department chair required.
prereq_text.CSC-496: Open by permission of instructor to students with more advanced prerequisites chosen by the instructor.
prereq_text.CSC-498: Prerequisite: CSC 231, CSC 235, CSC 236, senior standing and at least one computer science course at the 300 or 400 level.
prereq_text.MATH-223: Prerequisite: MATH 123 or MATH 136 or MATH 151.
prereq_text.MATH-261: Prerequisite: MATH 141 (or equivalent) or permission of instructor.
prereq_text.MATH-270: Prerequisite: MATH 152 or permission of instructor.
prereq_text.MATH-323: Prerequisites: CSC 233, foundations of computation or MATH 270, linear algebra or MATH 223, foundations of advanced mathematics. It will be beneficial for the student to be fluent in a programming language for this course.
prereq_text.MATH-331: Prerequisite: ECON 100 and MATH 136 or MATH 151 or ECON 375
prereq_text.MATH-332: Prerequisite: MATH/BUSA 331 which may be taken concurrently.
prereq_text.MATH-336: Prerequisite: MATH 136 or MATH 151 or ECON 375, ECON 100, and either MATH 141 or ECON 350.
prereq_text.MATH-341: Prerequisite: MATH 141 or ECON 350 or PSY 214 or BIO 275
prereq_text.MATH-348: Prerequisites: Math 141 (or ECON 350/BIO 375/PSY 214) and Math 151 (or MATH 135-136).
prereq_text.MATH-361: Prerequisite: MATH 152 and either MATH 223 or MATH 270.
prereq_text.MATH-367: Prerequisites: MATH 270 and CSC 121 or permission of instructor.
prereq_text.MATH-382: Prerequisite: MATH 270 or permission of instructor.
prereq_text.MATH-442: Prerequisite: MATH 441 which may be taken concurrently.
prereq_text.MATH-494: Prerequisite: MATH/BUSA 331 or MATH/BUSA 336, MATH 441, and one upper-level statistics course from the list (MATH 341, MATH 348, BUSA 305, ECON 385, ECON 450, FIN 451).
prereq_text.MATH-495: Open only to senior Mathematics majors or by permission of the Department of Mathematics.
